title: Building WhatsApp-Based Health Tech Networks in Low-Connectivity Environments
abstract: Delivered live keynote presentation and automated system demonstration of LifeDrop's architecture: asynchronous WhatsApp Cloud API webhooks, idempotent request queues for unreliable 2G connections, and zero-downtime health data alerting. Covers blood donor matching heuristics, MTN MoMo payment integration, and English/French bilingual conversational flows — all built to survive connectivity degradation.

title: LifeDrop End-to-End Demo
abstract: Full donor dispatch flow: WhatsApp prompt → matching heuristic → triage alert → MTN MoMo confirmation. Recorded on a 3G connection to demonstrate real-world resilience.

title: CoastClear Architecture Walkthrough
abstract: Multilingual AI waste coordination: English/French/Pidgin UI, photo-based waste classification, and community cleanup dispatch. Covers the Mapbox integration and synthetic training data pipeline.
